text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru and I have come to a local shrine, but before I can do any sort of praying…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So, are you ready?! Don't hold back…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Cleanse me of all evil spirits, I beg you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, I haven't been feeling too great lately. Then yesterday, the great Shiraoki appeared before me and said…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Have your destined partner cleanse you of evil spirits. Only then will you be able to take the next step."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So please, I'm begging you! My oh-so-divine Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I knew I could rely on you! They don't call you "Trusty Trainer" for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, repeat after me! Ready, and…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Squishy toe beans! Meow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh my… Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Guess who's been reborn! Me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: See! My aura's completely different, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What a relief! No more days cowering in the face of bad luck! And not only that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pfft, hahaha! That meow just now was priceless! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That was so funny, I could listen to that forev—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uh… hehe…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh! You wouldn't happen to be hungry, would you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Cleansing evil spirits really works up your appetite! Why don't we head back and grab something to eat?! Yeah, let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have mixed feelings about this, but at least Matikanefukukitaru has her energy back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meow? Mew mew…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meow?! Meooow?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru is desperately trying to communicate with her eyes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meow! Meow meow! (I think I've been possessed by a cat!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meow, meow meow meow! (It's probably angry about the cleansing ritual… Now it's gone and taken charge of my body!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the looks of it, she's angered an evil spirit enough for it to reveal itself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Meowwwww! (Nooo! What do I dooo?!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pull out all the stops to calm her down. She's soon back to speaking normally, but nothing can fix her mood.
